name: Uliana Sirotina
about: I lead engineering teams that care about purposeful work, empathy, and clarity. My background in front-end development helps me bridge product, design, and engineering - creating environments where people and products grow together.

experience.title: SoSafe - Engineering Team Lead
experience.summary: Joined as Senior Frontend Engineer, promoted to Team Lead within 4 months.
points: Lead a cross-functional squad of 5 engineers (frontend, backend, fullstack) owning the Customer and User domains; 8 engineers led over 2 years, through two rebuilds of the team

Rebuilt the team from merged parts - new PM, new designer, two developer pairs from different squads - and distributed technical ownership to the point of holding only 4 of 16 epics personally, backed by a support rotation and pair coding
Grew an engineer from QE to mid-level backend, coached a senior engineer out of underperformance, and managed one exit end to end, from calibration to separation
Ran end-to-end hiring for 2 engineers and trained 3 colleagues into the interview process, including one first-time hiring manager; authored hiring-process improvement proposals
Initiated and delivered automated accessibility tooling across two product platforms, with recurring metrics, leadership dashboards and documentation for org-wide rollout
Delivered the 2-digit to 4-digit language code migration unblocking locale variants across 5 teams; blocked a shortcut implementation by quantifying the ~2 months per team of debt it would create
Introduced sprint-based planning, velocity tracking and explicit prioritisation; deliberately halved sprint load to reinvest capacity into architecture, technical planning, bug triage and pairing
Led the technical investigation and director-level communication of a pricing incident affecting hundreds of customers, delivering root cause and a remediation plan to engineering and GTM leadership

Followed the incident with a product provisioning audit, run jointly with Product Analytics, that sized a seven-to-eight-figure ARR impact from over- and under-provisioning; drove a new CRM package-version field and a correction migration that made provisioning data fully reliable

experience.title: Uberall - Engineering Manager
experience.summary: Led a cross-functional squad of 6 owning review management: aggregating reviews from Google Maps, TripAdvisor and other partners into a single tool for customers to read, sort and respond to them.
points: Shipped Smart Conversations, a new product built on Google's newly launched Business Messages API, including an early AI auto-response system trained to resolve common customer enquiries without human involvement

Introduced Scrum from scratch to balance a defect-prone multi-partner ingestion pipeline against new product delivery: two-week sprints with capacity deliberately reserved for incremental fixes, so quality improved steadily without pausing feature work
Held the team together through an acquisition, a department reorganisation and repeated process changes: zero attrition over two years, with delivery cadence unbroken
Promoted one engineer to Senior, and mentored a backend engineer from another team into their first Team Lead role, advocating for them with leadership to make it happen
Frontend hiring manager for the engineering department: hired 13 frontend engineers across all teams, built the frontend hiring process and its documentation, and trained other engineers to interview
